name: Swiip: Calorie Counter & Gym
subtitle: AI workout and diet planner
description:
Most apps ask eight questions and hand you a programme. Swiip takes about four minutes too — but next to every exercise it tells you which of your answers put it there.

The app's interface is currently available in English and Turkish.

WHAT IT DOES
• Eight cards, about four minutes. Only questions that actually change your programme.
• A training programme built around where you train, what equipment you can reach and how many days you really have.
• Calorie and macro targets calculated from your own numbers.
• Food logging that is free and unlimited on every plan.
• A coach that answers using your data, not generic advice.

EVERY DECISION IS TRACEABLE
Under each exercise you can read why it is there: which answer, which rule. The explanation is not a sentence a language model made up — it is the solver's decision trail.

THE MATHS IS A FORMULA, THE LANGUAGE IS AI
Volume, progressive overload, deload, 1RM, calories and macros are all deterministic formulas. Language models are inconsistent at arithmetic and in a health context that is not acceptable. Add the same food twice and you get the same macros — every time. Nutrition values always come from a database.

WHAT WE DELIBERATELY DO NOT DO
• No badges, streaks, confetti or celebration animations.
• No ads or upsells for people who already pay.
• Cancelling is one tap, at the top of Settings, never hidden.
• Your body photo is deleted the moment it is analysed. Only the measurements are kept.
• Estimates are shown as ranges, never as a single number.

PLANS
Free: body analysis once, day one of your programme, manual calorie logging.
Basic and Pro add weekly progression, meal planning and — on Pro — food recognition from a photo.

Swiip is not a medical device and does not diagnose. The numbers it gives are estimates. If you have a health concern, talk to your doctor.

TERMS AND PRIVACY
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://swiip.app/en/privacy.html

play.title: Swiip: Calorie Counter & Gym
play.shortDescription: AI workout and diet planner with a calorie counter. Every move explained.
play.fullDescription:
Most apps ask eight questions and hand you a programme. Swiip takes about four minutes too — but next to every exercise it tells you which of your answers put it there.

"You told me you have a lower-back disc problem, so I swapped floor deadlifts for hip thrusts. Same muscle chain, no axial load on your spine."

The app's interface is currently available in English and Turkish.

WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone who wants to lose weight, gain weight or build muscle — whether you work out at the gym or at home with little or no equipment. Workouts for women and men alike, from full-body sessions to abs and glute work, set by your goal and level. A workout planner, diet plan, calorie counter and macro tracker in one app. Beginners and people who have trained for years both get a programme that fits their level, and a calorie deficit or surplus set from their own numbers, not a template.

WHAT IT DOES
• Eight cards, about four minutes. Only questions that actually change your programme.
• A workout plan built around where you train — gym or home — what equipment you can reach and how many days you really have.
• Calorie and macro targets calculated from your own numbers, with a calorie counter and food tracker that is free and unlimited on every plan.
• Barcode scanning, water tracking and a weekly meal plan.
• A coach that answers using your data, not generic advice.
• Three taps after each session — no logging sets on your phone at the gym. The next session is calculated from your feedback.

EVERY DECISION IS TRACEABLE
Under each exercise you can read why it is there: which answer, which rule. The explanation is not a sentence a language model made up — it is the solver's decision trail.

THE MATHS IS A FORMULA, THE LANGUAGE IS AI
Volume, progressive overload, deload, 1RM, calories and macros are all deterministic formulas. Add the same food twice and you get the same macros — every time. Nutrition values always come from a database; AI only answers "what food is this?".

WHAT WE DELIBERATELY DO NOT DO
• No badges, streaks, confetti or celebration animations.
• No ads or upsells for people who already pay.
• Cancelling is one tap, at the top of Settings, never hidden.
• Your body photo is deleted the moment it is analysed. Only the measurements are kept.
• Estimates are shown as ranges, never as a single number.
• Editing your programme is free and unlimited.

PLANS
Free: the eight-card assessment, body analysis once, day one of your programme, calorie and macro targets, manual food logging and barcode scanning.
Basic and Pro add every training day, weekly progression, meal planning and the AI coach — and on Pro, food recognition from a photo.

Payment is charged to your Google Play account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can turn off renewal in your Google Play account settings or with one tap inside the app; features stay on until the period ends.

HEALTH NOTICE
Swiip is not a medical device and does not diagnose. The numbers it gives are estimates. If you have a health concern, talk to your doctor. Swiip is for people aged 18 and over.

Privacy policy: https://swiip.app/en/privacy.html

talep.not: KARAR: anahtar alanının ~%70'i Türkçe. gb, in, ph, sg, ie, nz ve tr'de ölçüldü. İngilizce baş talep 'calorie counter', 'workout planner/tracker', 'gym workout', 'diet plan(ner)' — bunların hepsi AD ('Calorie Counter & Gym') ve ALT BAŞLIK ('AI workout and diet planner') üzerinden zaten kuruluyor; eski ad çoğul 'Calories' taşıyordu, ölçülen ifade tekil. Anahtar alanında İngilizceye kalan en büyük boşluk kamu dilindeki hedef: 'lose belly fat' (gb/in'de 'lose belly' ve 'belly fat' öneklerinin ilk sırası) ve 'lose weight / weight loss' → lose,belly,fat,weight,loss (23 karakter). Geri kalan ~72 karakter Türkiye için: tr mağazası tr + en-GB'yi birlikte tarıyor ve bu alan tr'nin İKİNCİ 100 karakteri. Türkiye birincil pazar; ~140 İngilizce mağazada baş terimler ad/alt başlıkla zaten karşılanıyor, oralarda kalan anahtar değeri (macro, protein, meal, tracker) Türkiye'deki ölçülmüş kamu talebinden ('fitness vücut geliştirme', 'kas yapma', 'spor salonu egzersizleri', 'kalori sayacı/açığı', 'göbek inceltme', 'kalça/bacak') düşük. tr anahtar alanına sığmayan bu terimler buraya alındı. 'şekillendirme' (vücut şekillendirme), 'beslenme' ve 'hareketleri' sığmadı — 'inceltme' ve 'kalça/bacak' koordinatörün ölçümünde daha kamu dili.
